title: BehaVerify: A Formal Verification Tool for Behavior Trees
abstract: arXiv:2611.22403v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents BehaVerify, a verification toolbox for behavior trees (BTs) and Neuro-Symbolic BTs. BTs are a graphical language for planning and sequencing behaviors - similar to extended state machines - and are increasingly used in safety-critical domains. BehaVerify enables users to specify a BT using a Domain Specific Language (DSL) with formal syntax and semantics. This language further includes Linear Temporal Logic and Computation Tree Logic specifications. BehaVerify uses an efficient encoding into nuXmv, called fastforwarding, to quickly verify if a specification holds over the BT. Additionally, BehaVerify can generate implementations of the BT in Python and Haskell. Through Python, BehaVerify has been integrated with PyTrees and Robot Operating System (ROS) and has been deployed to several autonomous robotic systems, including for verifying runtime monitors. translated_title: BehaVerify：一种面向行为树的形式化验证工具
translated_abstract: 本文提出了BehaVerify，一个面向行为树（BT）及神经符号行为树的验证工具箱。行为树是一种用于规划与排序行为的图形化语言，类似于扩展状态机，并且在安全关键领域的应用日益增多。BehaVerify使用户能够使用一种具有形式化语法和语义的领域特定语言（DSL）来描述行为树。该语言还支持线性时序逻辑（LTL）和计算树逻辑（CTL）规范。BehaVerify采用一种被称为“快进”的高效nuXmv编码方法，快速验证规范在行为树上是否成立。此外，BehaVerify还能生成行为树的Python和Haskell实现。通过Python，BehaVerify已与PyTrees和机器人操作系统（ROS）集成，并已部署到多个自主机器人系统中，包括用于验证运行时监控器。尽管先前的工作已经发展了底层理论，本文……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: BehaVerify是一个面向行为树及神经符号行为树的形式化验证工具箱，通过带形式语法与语义的DSL、时序逻辑规范以及高效的nuXmv编码实现快速验证，并能生成可集成于PyTrees和ROS的Python/Haskell实现。
en_tdlr: BehaVerify is a formal verification toolbox for behavior trees and Neuro-Symbolic BTs that enables rapid specification checking via a formal DSL with LTL/CTL support and an efficient nuXmv encoding, while also generating Python/Haskell implementations integrated with PyTrees and ROS.
